title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1,151–1,200 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: I would like to book a quiet single room for two nights.
examples.zh: 我想預訂一間安靜的單人房住兩晚。

examples.en: The single room has a private bathroom and a work desk.
examples.zh: 這間單人房配有獨立衛浴與一張辦公桌。

examples.en: Solo business travelers often prefer a single room over sharing.
examples.zh: 單獨出差的商務旅客通常偏好單人房而非與人同住。

examples.en: The couple reserved a deluxe double room with ocean views.
examples.zh: 這對夫妻預訂了一間面海的豪華雙人房。

examples.en: All double rooms in the hotel are equipped with king-size beds.
examples.zh: 飯店內所有的雙人房都配有特大號雙人床。

examples.en: Is breakfast included in the rate for a double room?
examples.zh: 雙人房的房價有包含早餐嗎？

examples.en: My friend and I preferred a twin room with separate beds.
examples.zh: 我和朋友偏好兩張單人床的雙床雙人房。

examples.en: We requested a non-smoking twin room on a higher floor.
examples.zh: 我們要求了一間位於較高樓層的禁菸雙床房。

examples.en: Twin rooms are ideal for coworkers attending the trade show together.
examples.zh: 雙床房非常適合一同參加商展的同事們。

examples.en: The presidential suite offers panoramic city views of Taipei 101.
examples.zh: 總統套房坐擁台北 101 的全景市景。

examples.en: They upgraded our reservation to a honeymoon suite for free.
examples.zh: 他們免費將我們的預訂升等至蜜月套房。

examples.en: The executive suite has a spacious living room and meeting area.
examples.zh: 行政套房擁有寬敞的客廳與會議空間。

examples.en: Tap your electronic key card to open the hotel room door.
examples.zh: 感應電子房卡以開啟飯店房間門。

examples.en: I accidentally demagnetized my key card by placing it near my phone.
examples.zh: 我不小心把房卡放在手機旁導致磁條消磁了。

examples.en: Please return both key cards to the front desk when checking out.
examples.zh: 退房時請將兩張房卡交還給櫃檯。

examples.en: We ordered hot chicken soup through room service late at night.
examples.zh: 我們深夜透過客房服務點了熱雞湯。

examples.en: Room service is available twenty-four hours a day at this five-star resort.
examples.zh: 這間五星級度假村全天二十四小時提供客房服務。

examples.en: There is an extra delivery fee for room service breakfast.
examples.zh: 客房服務早餐需額外支付送餐服務費。

examples.en: The tour group gathered in the hotel lobby before departure.
examples.zh: 觀光旅行團出發前在飯店大廳集合。

examples.en: A huge crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling of the main lobby.
examples.zh: 一座巨大的水晶吊燈懸掛在主大廳的天花板上。

examples.en: Free Wi-Fi is available for all guests in the lounge lobby.
examples.zh: 休息大廳為所有賓客提供免費無線網路。

examples.en: Please set a morning wake-up call for 6:00 AM.
examples.zh: 請幫我設定早上六點的電話叫醒服務。

examples.en: The hotel reception provided a friendly wake-up call right on time.
examples.zh: 飯店櫃檯準時提供了親切的電話叫醒服務。

examples.en: Missing his early flight was a serious wake-up call to manage time better.
examples.zh: 錯過早班飛機對他來說是個認真管理時間的嚴肅警鐘。

examples.en: The hotel breakfast buffet serves both Taiwanese and Western dishes.
examples.zh: 飯店早餐自助吧供應中式與西式料理。

examples.en: We enjoyed an all-you-can-eat seafood buffet on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 我們在週五晚上享用了海鮮吃到飽自助餐。

examples.en: Guests can choose from a wide selection of desserts at the buffet station.
examples.zh: 賓客可以在自助餐吧台挑選種類豐富的甜點。

examples.en: Could we please see the dessert and drink menu?
examples.zh: 請問能讓我們看一下甜點與飲品菜單嗎？

examples.en: Vegetarian dishes are clearly marked on the restaurant's dinner menu.
examples.zh: 餐廳晚餐菜單上明確標註了素食菜餚。

examples.en: Click on the navigation menu at the top of the webpage.
examples.zh: 點擊網頁頂端的導覽選單。

examples.en: We ordered crispy spring rolls as our starter appetizer.
examples.zh: 我們點了香脆春捲作為開胃前菜。

examples.en: Cold appetizers were served along with sparkling cider.
examples.zh: 冰涼的開胃菜與氣泡蘋果西打一同上桌。

examples.en: Garlic bread and mushroom soup make a wonderful dinner appetizer.
examples.zh: 大蒜麵包與蘑菇濃湯是非常棒的晚餐前菜。

examples.en: For the main course, I will have the grilled salmon fillet.
examples.zh: 主菜部分，我想要烤鮭魚排。

examples.en: What side dish comes with the steak main course?
examples.zh: 請問牛排主餐隨附的配菜是什麼？

examples.en: The waiter brought out the main course shortly after we finished our soup.
examples.zh: 我們喝完湯不久，服務生就端上了主菜。

examples.en: Tofu pudding with boba is a classic Taiwanese dessert.
examples.zh: 珍珠豆花是經典的台灣特色甜點。

examples.en: Save some room in your stomach for chocolate lava dessert.
examples.zh: 肚子留點空間享用巧克力熔岩甜點。

examples.en: We decided to share a bowl of mango shaved ice for dessert.
examples.zh: 我們決定飯後合吃一碗芒果雪花冰當作甜點。

examples.en: Cold alcoholic beverages are prohibited for minors.
examples.zh: 未成年人禁止飲用冰涼含酒精飲料。

examples.en: The flight attendant offered complimentary hot and cold beverages.
examples.zh: 空服員提供了免費的冷熱飲品。

examples.en: Staying hydrated with healthy beverages like green tea is good for health.
examples.zh: 多喝像綠茶這類健康飲料補充水分對身體有益。

examples.en: Excuse me, may we have the bill now?
examples.zh: 不好意思，請問我們可以買單結帳了嗎？

examples.en: Shall we split the dinner bill equally among the four of us?
examples.zh: 我們四個人平分這筆晚餐帳單好嗎？

examples.en: The utility bill for electricity was unusually high this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天的電費水電帳單異常高昂。

examples.en: In the US, it is customary to leave a 15% tip.
examples.zh: 在美國，留下 15% 的小費是當地的慣例。

examples.en: Here is a helpful tip to improve your daily English listening skills.
examples.zh: 這裡有一個改善你日常英語聽力技巧的實用秘訣。

examples.en: The waiter smiled gratefully when we gave him a generous tip.
examples.zh: 當我們給了豐厚的小費時，服務生感激地微笑致意。

examples.en: A 10% service charge is already included in the bill.
examples.zh: 帳單中已包含一成（10%）服務費。

examples.en: Upscale dining establishments usually add an automatic service charge.
examples.zh: 高檔餐廳通常會自動加收服務費。

examples.en: Does this total price include tax and the hotel service charge?
examples.zh: 這個總價有包含稅金與飯店服務費嗎？

examples.en: What local dishes do you highly recommend here?
examples.zh: 請問您在這裡強烈推薦哪道在地菜餚？

examples.en: I recommend studying at least thirty minutes of vocabulary every day.
examples.zh: 我建議每天至少研讀三十分鐘的單字。

examples.en: The doctor recommended taking a walk after each heavy meal.
examples.zh: 醫生建議每頓大餐後都要散散步。

examples.en: Following the chef's recommendation, we ordered the beef soup.
examples.zh: 依照主廚的推薦，我們點了清燉牛肉湯。

examples.en: My professor kindly wrote a strong letter of recommendation for me.
examples.zh: 我的教授好心地為我寫了一封有力的推薦信。

examples.en: Can you give me some book recommendations for beginners?
examples.zh: 你能給我一些適合初學者的書籍推薦嗎？

examples.en: Xiao Long Bao (soup dumplings) is this restaurant's specialty.
examples.zh: 小籠包是這家餐廳的招牌特色料理。

examples.en: Sun cakes and pineapple pastries are famous specialties of Taichung.
examples.zh: 太陽餅與鳳梨酥是台中的著名特產伴手禮。

examples.en: Pediatric medicine is Dr. Lee's medical specialty.
examples.zh: 小兒醫學是李醫師的醫療專業領域。

examples.en: Fresh local ingredients make this seafood soup delicious.
examples.zh: 新鮮的在地食材讓這道海鮮湯十分美味。

examples.en: Read the label carefully if you are allergic to certain food ingredients.
examples.zh: 如果你對某些食物成分過敏，請仔細閱讀標籤。

examples.en: Hard work and patience are key ingredients for long-term success.
examples.zh: 勤奮與耐心是長期成功的關鍵要素。

examples.en: Grandma shared her secret braised pork recipe with me.
examples.zh: 奶奶跟我分享了她私房滷肉的秘製食譜。

examples.en: Follow the online recipe step-by-step to bake fresh sourdough bread.
examples.zh: 依照線上食譜的步驟一步步烘烤新鮮酸種麵包。

examples.en: Driving while exhausted is a sure recipe for a serious traffic accident.
examples.zh: 疲勞駕駛無疑是引發重大車禍事故的危險因子。

examples.en: Boil the dumplings in water for six to eight minutes.
examples.zh: 將水餃放入水中滾煮六至八分鐘。

examples.en: The water in the pot began to boil vigorously.
examples.zh: 鍋裡的水開始劇烈滾騰。

examples.en: Hard-boiled eggs are a convenient source of healthy protein.
examples.zh: 水煮蛋是補充優質蛋白質的便利來源。

examples.en: Fry the eggs sunny-side up for breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐煎幾顆太陽蛋。

examples.en: Pan-fry the fish fillets over medium heat until golden.
examples.zh: 用中火將魚排煎至表面金黃。

examples.en: She fried diced potatoes with onions and black pepper.
examples.zh: 她將馬鈴薯丁與洋蔥和黑胡椒一同翻煎。

examples.en: Stir-fry the seasonal vegetables with minced garlic.
examples.zh: 用蒜末大火快炒時令蔬菜。

examples.en: Taiwanese stir-fry restaurants are popular gathering spots after work.
examples.zh: 台灣的熱炒店是下班後非常熱門的聚會場所。

examples.en: Stir-fry the sliced beef quickly to keep it tender and juicy.
examples.zh: 將牛肉片迅速大火快炒以保持軟嫩多汁。

examples.en: Deep-fry the chicken cutlet until it turns golden brown.
examples.zh: 將雞排油炸至呈現金黃酥脆的顏色。

examples.en: Deep-fried tofu tastes best when dipped in thick garlic soy sauce.
examples.zh: 炸豆腐沾上濃郁蒜蓉醬油膏吃起來最美味。

examples.en: It is healthier to bake food rather than deep-fry it in oil.
examples.zh: 烘烤食物通常比用油酥炸來得更加健康。

examples.en: We baked fresh chocolate chip cookies on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們在週日烘烤了新鮮巧克力豆餅乾。

examples.en: The bakery bakes several hundred loaves of artisan bread every morning.
examples.zh: 這家烘焙坊每天清晨烘烤數百條歐式手作麵包。

examples.en: Bake the apple pie at two hundred degrees Celsius for forty minutes.
examples.zh: 將蘋果派放入攝氏兩百度的烤箱中烘烤四十分鐘。

examples.en: Roast duck has a wonderfully crispy skin.
examples.zh: 烤鴨的外皮格外香脆可口。

examples.en: Mom roasted a whole chicken with rosemary and baby carrots.
examples.zh: 媽媽用迷迭香和小胡蘿蔔烤了一整隻全雞。

examples.en: Freshly roasted coffee beans fill the entire cafe with rich aroma.
examples.zh: 現烘咖啡豆讓整間咖啡館瀰漫著濃郁香氣。

examples.en: Grill the sweet corn and sausages over charcoal.
examples.zh: 在木炭上燒烤甜玉米和香腸。

examples.en: We set up an outdoor barbecue grill in the backyard for Mid-Autumn Festival.
examples.zh: 中秋節時我們在後院架設了戶外烤肉架。

examples.en: The chef grilled the fresh tuna steaks to perfection.
examples.zh: 主廚將新鮮鮪魚排烤得恰到好處、完美無瑕。

examples.en: Steam the pork buns for ten minutes before serving.
examples.zh: 上桌前將肉包放進蒸籠蒸十分鐘。

examples.en: Clouds of hot steam rose from the bamboo dumpling baskets.
examples.zh: 陣陣滾燙的蒸氣從竹製蒸籠中裊裊升起。

examples.en: Steamed vegetables retain more natural vitamins and nutrients than boiled ones.
examples.zh: 清蒸蔬菜比水煮蔬菜保留了更多天然維生素與營養。

examples.en: Slice the ripe watermelon into thick juicy wedges.
examples.zh: 將熟透的西瓜切成厚實多汁的切片。

examples.en: Would you like another slice of homemade strawberry cheesecake?
examples.zh: 你想再來一片自製的草莓起司蛋糕嗎？

examples.en: He sliced through the packaging tape with a sharp utility knife.
examples.zh: 他用鋒利的美工刀劃開了包裝膠帶。

examples.en: Chop the fresh green onions into fine pieces.
examples.zh: 將新鮮青蔥切成細末。

examples.en: He chopped firewood in the forest before winter arrived.
examples.zh: 他在寒冬來臨前在森林裡劈砍柴火。

examples.en: We ordered pan-seared pork chops with mashed potatoes.
examples.zh: 我們點了香煎豬排佐馬鈴薯泥。

examples.en: Peel the sweet banana before eating it.
examples.zh: 吃香蕉前先剝掉外皮。

examples.en: She carefully peeled the potatoes with a stainless steel peeler.
examples.zh: 她用不鏽鋼削皮器仔細削去馬鈴薯皮。

examples.en: Sunburn caused the skin on his shoulders to peel off.
examples.zh: 曬傷導致他肩膀上的皮膚開始脫皮。

examples.en: Mix the flour, eggs, and milk thoroughly in a large bowl.
examples.zh: 在大碗中將麵粉、雞蛋和牛奶徹底混合均勻。

examples.en: Oil and water do not mix naturally without an emulsifier.
examples.zh: 沒有乳化劑的情況下油和水自然不會融合相溶。

examples.en: The playlist is a fun mix of pop hits and classic rock ballads.
examples.zh: 這份播放清單融合了流行金曲與經典搖滾抒情歌。

examples.en: Stir the hot soup gently with a wooden spoon.
examples.zh: 用木匙輕輕攪拌熱湯。

examples.en: Stir two spoonfuls of sugar into your black coffee.
examples.zh: 在黑咖啡中拌入兩匙砂糖。

examples.en: The exciting news stirred great excitement among the young students.
examples.zh: 這個令人振奮的消息在年輕學生之間激起了熱烈迴響。

examples.en: Pour fresh cold milk into your morning cereal.
examples.zh: 將冰涼新鮮牛奶倒進你的早餐麥片中。

examples.en: It began to pour down with heavy rain as soon as we stepped outside.
examples.zh: 我們一走出門外，天空就開始下起傾盆大雨。

examples.en: He poured a glass of iced tea for every guest at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 他為餐桌上的每位賓客倒了一杯冰紅茶。

collocations: it never rains but it pours

examples.en: Heat some olive oil in the non-stick frying pan.
examples.zh: 在不沾平底鍋中加熱少許橄欖油。

examples.en: Gently flip the pancake over in the hot frying pan.
examples.zh: 在熱平底鍋中將煎餅輕輕翻面。

examples.en: Clean the frying pan with a soft sponge to preserve the non-stick coating.
examples.zh: 用柔軟的海綿清洗平底鍋以保護不沾塗層。

examples.en: Put the beef chunks into the hot pot to simmer.
examples.zh: 把牛肉塊放入熱湯鍋中慢火燉煮。

examples.en: She planted colorful petunias in a large ceramic flower pot.
examples.zh: 她在大陶花盆裡栽種了色彩繽紛的矮牽牛。

examples.en: Keep the heavy lid firmly on the pot while cooking rice.
examples.zh: 煮飯時請將厚重的鍋蓋緊緊蓋在鍋子上。

examples.en: A carbon steel wok creates the authentic 'wok hei' aroma.
examples.zh: 碳鋼炒鍋能炒出最道地的鑊氣香氣。

examples.en: Heat the seasoned wok until it begins to smoke slightly.
examples.zh: 將開好鍋的炒鍋加熱至微微冒煙。

examples.en: Street food vendors toss fried rice skillfully in large iron woks.
examples.zh: 街頭小吃攤販在大型鐵鍋中熟練地翻炒炒飯。

examples.en: Place the delicate coffee cup on the ceramic saucer.
examples.zh: 將精緻的咖啡杯放在陶瓷茶碟上。

examples.en: The antique porcelain cup and saucer set was passed down from grandmother.
examples.zh: 這套骨董瓷杯茶碟組是外婆傳承下來的。

examples.en: A little kitten lapped fresh milk greedily from a white saucer.
examples.zh: 小貓咪貪婪地舔食著白色小碟子裡的鮮奶。

examples.en: The tea master brewed fragrant Oolong tea in a clay teapot.
examples.zh: 茶藝師在紫砂茶壺中沖泡香醇烏龍茶。

examples.en: Be careful when holding the handle because the metal teapot is scorching hot.
examples.zh: 拿握把手時要小心，因為金屬茶壺非常滾燙。

examples.en: She poured boiling hot water from the kettle into the porcelain teapot.
examples.zh: 她將熱水壺裡的沸水注入瓷茶壺中。

examples.en: Boil water in the electric kettle to make hot tea.
examples.zh: 用快煮壺燒開水來泡熱茶。

examples.en: The whistling kettle on the stove announced that the water was boiling.
examples.zh: 瓦斯爐上發出鳴笛聲的水壺宣告水已經燒開了。

examples.en: We bought an automatic shut-off kettle for convenience and safety.
examples.zh: 為了便利與安全，我們買了一台自動斷電的快煮壺。

examples.en: Microwave your bento box for two minutes on high heat.
examples.zh: 將便當用高火微波加熱兩分鐘。

examples.en: Do not place any aluminum foil or metal bowls inside the microwave.
examples.zh: 切勿將鋁箔紙或金屬碗放進微波爐內。

examples.en: The office pantry is equipped with two microwave ovens for employee lunches.
examples.zh: 辦公室茶水間備有兩台微波爐供員工加熱午餐。

examples.en: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees before baking the cake.
examples.zh: 烤蛋糕前先將烤箱預熱至攝氏 180 度。

examples.en: Take the baking tray out of the oven using heatproof oven mitts.
examples.zh: 使用防燙隔熱手套將烤盤從烤箱中取出。

examples.en: The aroma of roasting garlic bread filled the kitchen as the oven heated up.
examples.zh: 隨著烤箱加溫，烘烤大蒜麵包的香氣瀰漫了整個廚房。

examples.en: Pop two slices of white bread into the electric toaster.
examples.zh: 將兩片白吐司放入烤麵包機中。

examples.en: The shiny four-slice toaster browns bread slices evenly and quickly.
examples.zh: 這台光亮的四片式烤麵包機能迅速均勻地烘烤吐司片。

examples.en: Unplug the toaster before trying to remove stuck bread crusts.
examples.zh: 在設法夾出卡住的吐司邊之前，請先拔掉烤麵包機插頭。

examples.en: Use the kitchen blender to make a creamy papaya smoothie.
examples.zh: 用果汁機打一杯濃郁滑順的木瓜冰沙。

examples.en: The high-speed blender can easily crush ice cubes and frozen berries.
examples.zh: 這台高速調理機能輕鬆絞碎冰塊與冷凍莓果。

examples.en: Rinse the blender pitcher immediately after preparing fruit juice.
examples.zh: 調製完果汁後應立即沖洗調理機攪拌杯。

examples.en: What ice cream flavor would you like to try?
examples.zh: 你想嘗試哪一種冰淇淋口味？

examples.en: Adding fresh basil gives the pasta sauce a rich herbal flavor.
examples.zh: 加入新鮮羅勒能賦予義大利麵醬濃郁的草本風味。

examples.en: The chef experimented with different spice blends to enhance flavor profiles.
examples.zh: 主廚嘗試了不同的香料組合以提升整體的風味層次。

examples.en: The night market stinky tofu smells strong but tastes amazing!
examples.zh: 夜市臭豆腐聞起來味道濃烈但吃起來極為美味！

examples.en: I love the relaxing smell of lavender essential oil before sleeping.
examples.zh: 我很喜歡睡前薰衣草精油散發的放鬆氣味。

examples.en: Dogs have a keen sense of smell that helps them track lost people.
examples.zh: 狗狗擁有敏銳的嗅覺，能幫助牠們搜救失蹤人員。

examples.en: These organic vegetables were picked fresh this morning.
examples.zh: 這些有機蔬菜是今天早上剛採摘的新鮮貨。

examples.en: Open the bedroom window to let in some crisp fresh morning air.
examples.zh: 打開臥室窗戶讓清爽的早晨新鮮空氣流通進來。

examples.en: After taking a cold shower, he felt completely refreshed and ready to work.
examples.zh: 沖完冷水澡後，他感到通體舒暢且充滿幹勁準備工作。

examples.en: The braised beef shank noodles are incredibly delicious.
examples.zh: 這裡的紅燒牛腱肉麵好吃得令人驚艷。

examples.en: Thank you for hosting us and preparing such a delicious home-cooked dinner.
examples.zh: 感謝您的熱情款待並準備了如此美味的家常豐盛晚餐。

examples.en: Fresh tropical mangoes taste extraordinarily sweet and delicious in summer.
examples.zh: 新鮮熱帶芒果在夏天吃起來格外香甜美味。
